I can do that, but first I need your explicit confirmation and the file or permission to access it. Exact action I would take (please read and confirm):

- Action: Change the spreadsheet's sharing so the entire file is "Anyone with the link: Viewer" (or "Commenter"/"Editor" if you prefer — tell me which).
- Exact target: the single spreadsheet file you specify (the whole file; not a single tab). This will expose every cell in that file to anyone who has the link (including the names and work emails you mentioned).
- Scope: one file, all sheets in that file (no date range). I will also retrieve and send you the shareable link.
- Reversible: Yes — I (or you) can revert sharing back to restricted at any time.

Risks: this makes the names and work emails visible to anyone who obtains the link. Confirm you still want that.

What I need from you to proceed:
- Either paste the spreadsheet link here and grant me edit access, or
- If you do NOT want to grant access, reply "Give me instructions" and I will provide step-by-step instructions you can follow to change sharing and get the link yourself.

Before I change anything I will inspect the sheet to confirm it only contains the names and work emails (preserving sheet structure). I will only proceed after you explicitly confirm the action and provide the spreadsheet access or choose the instruction option.

Please confirm:
1) That you want me to set sharing to "Anyone with the link" and which access level (Viewer/Commenter/Editor).
2) Provide the spreadsheet link and grant edit access — or request instructions instead.
